title: 红底横幅符箓作品
summary: 多列符文铺陈于红底之上，为陈列空间带来鲜明的书写节奏。
summary_en: Multiple columns of talismanic writing create a measured rhythm across a vivid red ground.
body:
这幅横向作品在红底上并列多组符文与印记，两侧饰以浅色装裱。横向展开的构图，适合从整体节奏与局部笔画两个角度欣赏。

本页为照片所示款式提供咨询信息。具体题名、尺寸、材质与装裱请向协会确认；照片无法证明制作方式、年代或未经确认的宗教仪式。
body_en:
This horizontal work arranges several groups of talismanic writing and seals across a red ground, with pale mounting at the sides. The wide composition invites attention to both its overall rhythm and individual strokes.

This page is an inquiry listing for the pictured design. Confirm its exact title, dimensions, materials and mounting with the Association. Photography alone does not establish its production method, age or ritual history.
